title: My Heart Is Fixed; I Will Sing and Praise
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands on a rooftop terrace above ancient Jerusalem before dawn. He holds a lyre and looks toward the paling sky, prepared to sing and praise the LORD with a steadfast heart. A few musicians join him, while the city below remains quiet and its oil lamps begin to fade. The sky fills much of the composition, symbolizing the psalm's declaration that God's mercy reaches above the heavens and His truth reaches to the clouds. David raises one hand toward the sky, asking that God's glory be exalted and that His people be delivered. The scene should express confidence, worship, and the expectation that divine steadfast love will bring help to the beloved people. Do not depict God as a physical being in the clouds. Use ancient Israelite architecture, realistic lyres and garments, and soft dawn light. No modern instruments, stage lights, text, or fantasy effects.

title: With God We Shall Do Valiantly
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands with a group of Israelite leaders on a high ridge overlooking valleys, fortified towns, and the roads connecting neighboring territories. A messenger arrives with information about the surrounding region, and David points toward the land while acknowledging God's authority over it. The setting may visually suggest Shechem, Succoth, Gilead, Manasseh, Ephraim, Moab, and Edom as remembered in the psalm, but it should not present modern borders or claim that all places are visible in one exact panorama. Several soldiers prepare their equipment in the background, while elders pray for guidance before a campaign. The central message is that human assistance alone is insufficient and that confidence must rest in God, who enables the people to act with courage. Keep the scene sober and non-graphic, with historically plausible shields, spears, clothing, and rugged terrain. No modern maps, military equipment, flags, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: They Have Repaid Me Evil for Good
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite courtyard where David stands accused by several men who once received kindness from him. One accuser speaks with exaggerated gestures, another whispers to a listener, and a third points toward David as if presenting a false account. David remains still, with an expression of pain and disappointment, and turns toward the LORD in prayer rather than answering every accusation with counteraccusations. In a smaller detail at the edge of the scene, David is remembered as helping a needy neighbor carry provisions through the same courtyard, contrasting his former kindness with the hostility he now faces. The setting should communicate false accusation, hatred without cause, and the sorrow of being repaid evil for good. Do not stage a literal battle or portray anyone being injured. Use historically plausible Israelite robes, limestone walls, clay jars, woven baskets, and natural light. No modern courtroom objects, readable text, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: A Severe Appeal for Justice against False Accusers
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David kneels in a quiet stone chamber, speaking earnestly to God after a sustained campaign of false accusations and betrayal. He wears simple clothing and has set aside the symbols of royal status. Nearby, a low table holds a clay lamp and an unrolled but unreadable parchment. Through the open doorway, hostile men can be seen conversing outside, appearing confident that their false reports will prevail. David's expression is intense as he asks God to bring judgment upon wickedness and to prevent his accusers from continuing to harm him and his household. The emotional weight of the psalm's severe imprecations should be conveyed through solemn posture and the contrast between the prayerful room and the hostile street, not through graphic consequences or depictions of suffering. The image should preserve the fact that the psalm is an anguished appeal for justice rather than a peaceful reflection. Authentic ancient garments, stone architecture, and lamplight. No modern objects, graphic violence, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Help Me for Your Name's Sake
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David sits on a stone bench inside a modest dwelling, visibly weakened by distress and the burden of repeated hostility. His cloak hangs loosely from his shoulders, and a walking staff rests nearby. He raises one hand in prayer, pleading for help because of God's steadfast love rather than his own standing. Outside the doorway, several people pass by without stopping, while a trusted companion returns with water and sits near him. David's expression conveys humility and urgency, asking not to be put to shame and hoping that the LORD will answer the accusations with deliverance. Keep the depiction dignified and non-graphic, showing emotional and physical weariness through posture rather than illness detail. The room's simple furnishings and narrow opening emphasize vulnerability, while sunlight begins to reach the floor, offering a restrained visual hint of hope. Historically plausible ancient clothing, clay vessels, woven mats, and natural light. No modern medical equipment, text, or fantasy effects.

title: I Will Greatly Praise the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands among a small group of humble worshippers in an ancient Israelite courtyard. His expression is grateful as he praises the LORD with his whole heart and acknowledges that God stands at the right hand of the needy to save them from those who condemn them. A musician accompanies him on a simple lyre, and an elder stands beside a poor neighbor who has received fair treatment after being falsely accused. The gathering is modest rather than triumphant, reflecting that praise follows a plea for justice and does not require public humiliation of the adversaries. A stone gate and a clear path toward the surrounding hills provide the background. The scene should convey confidence that God defends the vulnerable and the psalmist's decision to praise Him openly. Authentic ancient robes, realistic stonework, and natural morning light. No modern instruments, written captions, or fantasy effects.

title: The King at God's Right Hand
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with solemn royal symbolism. An Israelite king sits in a dignified court, listening as a trusted prophet or royal messenger conveys a divine promise of authority and victory. The king's posture is attentive and humble, and his royal garments are historically plausible rather than extravagant. A raised seat stands beside the main throne, representing the psalm's royal image of sitting at the right hand until enemies are made a footstool. In the background, young warriors assemble in orderly ranks, prepared to serve the king, while the dawn light touches the city walls. The composition should evoke royal authority, willing service, and the psalm's language of a scepter from Zion, without depicting God as a visible human figure or claiming to document one specific enthronement. Use ancient Israelite architecture, simple royal furnishings, realistic garments, and natural light. No European medieval armor, modern uniforms, text, or fantasy effects.

title: A Priest Forever and a King Who Judges the Nations
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite royal court and sanctuary precinct shown in a composed, symbolic scene. A king stands beside a respected priestly figure wearing historically plausible garments, emphasizing the psalm's unusual language about a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek. The figures are not presented as a documented historical meeting, but as visual representations of kingship and priesthood joined in the psalm's royal poem. Nearby, elders listen solemnly, and attendants prepare a formal procession outside the gate. A distant valley and broad horizon suggest the psalm's imagery of judgment among nations and the king's ultimate victory. Avoid graphic warfare or a literal depiction of heads being crushed. Use ancient Near Eastern stone architecture, woven robes, simple ceremonial objects, and natural sunlight. No Christian-era vestments, European crowns, modern symbols, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Great Are the Works of the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite assembly gathers in a modest courtyard to praise the LORD with the whole heart. An elder stands near a small group of musicians and gestures toward a scroll as he recounts God's great works, righteousness, grace, and compassion. In the surrounding landscape, farmers tend their fields, shepherds guide flocks, and families share food, showing how daily life is sustained by divine provision. A child sits close to the elder, listening to the story of God's works and remembering that the LORD provides food and keeps His covenant. The composition should emphasize that God's works are studied by those who delight in them and that His power has been displayed in giving His people an inheritance. Use historically plausible Israelite clothing, realistic stonework, simple agricultural tools, and natural daylight. No modern books, printed text, or fantasy effects.

title: The Fear of the LORD Is the Beginning of Wisdom
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a father and an elder teach a group of young Israelites in a village courtyard. The elder explains the importance of God's precepts, faithfulness, justice, and reverent obedience. One young person helps an elderly neighbor carry a basket while another carefully measures grain honestly at a market table, demonstrating that wisdom appears in daily conduct. In the background, a sanctuary entrance is visible, where worshippers gather respectfully. The scene should communicate that God's commandments are trustworthy and established, that redemption belongs to Him, and that the fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. Avoid turning the lesson into a modern classroom or depicting fear as panic; show reverence, seriousness, and practical understanding. Historically plausible garments, clay vessels, stone architecture, and soft natural light. No modern teaching tools, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: Blessed Is the One Who Fears the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a modest but thriving ancient Israelite household in the morning. A father teaches his children to honor God, while the family prepares food and shares provisions with a neighbor. Their home is built of stone and mudbrick, with woven mats, clay jars, and simple wooden furniture. In the background, their field produces a healthy crop and a small flock grazes nearby, symbolizing the psalm's language of descendants, blessing, and enduring righteousness. A visitor arrives with a problem, and the household head listens kindly before offering practical help, reflecting the qualities of generosity, discretion, and fair conduct. The image should not imply that every faithful household becomes wealthy or escapes all hardship; it should express a life shaped by reverence and uprightness. Use authentic ancient Israelite clothing, realistic agricultural details, warm sunlight, and natural facial expressions. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Light Rises in the Darkness for the Upright
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an upright Israelite stands calmly in an ancient town during a time of uncertainty. In the foreground, he gives a small portion of grain to a needy family and helps an older neighbor cross an uneven path. His face shows trust rather than fear as unsettling news travels through the town and some residents become anxious. A lamp shines from his open doorway, while dawn begins to break over the rooftops, symbolizing the light that rises for the upright in darkness. In the background, a proud man who had boasted of his status watches the generosity with displeasure, unable to understand the quiet strength of the faithful person's conduct. The scene should communicate generosity, justice, steadfast trust, and the contrast between lasting righteousness and the passing frustration of the wicked. Avoid portraying the righteous person as immune to sorrow. Historically plausible clothing, stone streets, clay lamps, and natural light. No modern objects, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: From the Rising of the Sun to Its Setting
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite worshipper gathers with others on a rooftop terrace at sunrise to praise the name of the LORD. The early sun rises over the eastern hills, illuminating stone homes and the distant sanctuary. Musicians hold lyres and simple hand drums, while an elder raises his hands and invites the community to bless God's name continually. The sky extends across the composition, emphasizing that praise belongs to the LORD from the rising of the sun to its setting and that His glory is above all nations. The worshippers' faces reflect reverence and gladness. Keep the scene modest and culturally appropriate for ancient Israel, with simple woven garments, stone parapets, and oil lamps being extinguished as daylight arrives. Do not depict God as a visible figure in the sky. No modern instruments, city skylines, printed words, or fantasy effects.

title: He Raises the Poor from the Dust
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a humble Israelite family sits near a modest doorway at the edge of an ancient settlement. A poor mother holds a young child while an elder brings food and offers them a secure place in the household. The mother receives the help with gratitude and dignity, not shame. In the background, a barren patch of land begins to show renewed life after rainfall, while a household with children gathers in a sunlit courtyard. The scene symbolizes the psalm's declaration that the LORD raises the poor from the dust, lifts the needy, and grants dignity and belonging to those who have been overlooked. The image should not portray God as a literal human lifting someone by the arm; instead, it expresses divine compassion through restoration and community support. Use historically plausible Israelite clothing, simple stone homes, woven mats, clay vessels, and soft natural daylight. No modern welfare settings, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: When Israel Went Out of Egypt
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, the Israelites leave Egypt as a vast group of families move along a dusty road toward the wilderness. Moses and other leaders walk at the front, and people carry bundles, water jars, and simple household goods while guiding sheep and goats. A broad view of the landscape includes the Egyptian agricultural plain and the open road into the dry country beyond. In a more distant section of the composition, the terrain transitions toward the sea and the mountains, reflecting the psalm's poetic recollection of the sea fleeing and mountains and hills leaping. These natural features should not literally move like living creatures; their dramatic appearance symbolizes creation responding to God's deliverance. The atmosphere should be one of urgent movement, awe, and hope for freedom. Authentic ancient garments, realistic animals, dusty terrain, and natural sunlight. No modern vehicles, fantasy effects, or graphic danger.

title: The Earth Trembles Before the LORD
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with dramatic natural scenery representing the psalm's poetic question about the sea, river, mountains, and hills responding to God's presence. A broad body of water is shown retreating from a rocky shore, revealing a passage of firm ground across a previously submerged area. Beyond it, rugged mountains rise beneath a dramatic sky, while small streams emerge among rocks and flow into the valley. A few Israelites stand on safe ground, watching in awe as the landscape suggests the remembered wilderness deliverance. In the foreground, water flows from a rough rock formation, recalling the image of God bringing water from the rock. The composition must remain naturalistic and should not show the mountains literally dancing or the earth cracking open in a disaster. Use realistic terrain, water, ancient clothing, and believable daylight. No modern engineering structures, supernatural creatures, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Not unto Us, but unto Your Name Give Glory
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite worshipper stands before a simple sanctuary entrance, humbly gesturing toward the sky as the community gives glory to the LORD rather than to human achievement. Nearby, a group of travelers from a neighboring region asks where Israel's God can be seen, while an elder responds through calm gestures toward the sanctuary and the surrounding life of the community. At the edge of the courtyard, several people stand before carved metal and wooden idols with faces and hands that cannot respond, symbolizing the psalm's contrast between living trust in God and lifeless manufactured images. Avoid portraying adherents of other religions as grotesque or treating them as objects of ridicule; the contrast should center on the psalm's theological claim. Use historically plausible ancient Near Eastern idols and Israelite architecture, simple garments, clay vessels, and natural light. No modern religious symbols, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: The LORD Is Our Help and Shield
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite household gathers in a courtyard for a simple act of prayer and thanksgiving. Parents, children, servants, and elders stand together, while a small woven basket of grain and a clay vessel of oil sit on a low table. A soldier places his shield beside the doorway, symbolizing that the LORD is the true help and shield of Israel, while the family expresses gratitude for blessing and provision. In the background, young people work in a field and a shepherd leads a flock across green hills, reflecting the psalm's blessing upon the people and their descendants and the contrast between the living praising God and the silence of death. The composition should feel warm, reverent, and grounded in ordinary life. Do not imply that the family has no future difficulties. Authentic ancient Israelite garments, realistic tools, stone architecture, and natural sunlight. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: I Love the LORD Because He Heard My Voice
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper walks along a path from a shadowed rocky valley toward a sunlit settlement. His face shows relief and gratitude after a period of distress in which he felt close to death and called upon the LORD for help. A small group of companions waits near the city gate, ready to welcome him home. In a quiet moment along the path, the worshipper pauses to raise his hands in prayer, acknowledging that God is gracious, righteous, and merciful. The landscape transitions naturally from steep rocky ground to a broader, safer road, symbolizing rescue and renewed life. Avoid graphic depictions of danger or a literal vision of death. The image should communicate that the worshipper has been delivered and will continue walking before the LORD in the land of the living. Use historically plausible travel clothing, stone paths, olive trees, and natural light. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: I Will Lift Up the Cup of Salvation
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite sanctuary courtyard during a thanksgiving gathering. The worshipper who has been delivered stands among family and neighbors, holding a simple cup as a symbolic expression of gratitude for the LORD's salvation. He prepares to fulfill his vows publicly, while an elder listens and a musician plays a lyre. A modest table carries bread, fruit, and a clay vessel of wine appropriate to ancient Israelite culture. The gathering should express the seriousness of giving thanks, honoring the lives of God's faithful people, and acknowledging that the worshipper belongs to the LORD. Do not depict a modern communion service or a specific later religious rite. The courtyard is surrounded by stone walls and woven curtains, with warm natural light entering from above. Authentic ancient garments, pottery, and realistic expressions. No modern glasses, printed liturgy, or fantasy effects.

title: Praise the LORD, All Nations
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an open courtyard in ancient Israel where a small gathering of local worshippers stands among travelers from different regions of the ancient Near East. Their clothing, head coverings, sandals, and travel goods vary according to regional traditions, yet they share a moment of reverent praise. An elder lifts his hands toward the sky and invites all peoples to praise the LORD because His steadfast love is great and His truth endures forever. The sanctuary entrance and surrounding hills are visible in the background, while natural morning sunlight illuminates the faces of the gathered people. The image should communicate the psalm's concise but universal invitation to praise God, without inventing a large political assembly or making the scene look modern. Use historically plausible architecture, ancient garments, and natural light. No contemporary national flags, microphones, printed text, or fantasy effects.

title: His Mercy Endures Forever
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of Israelites gathers at a sanctuary entrance to give thanks to the LORD for His enduring mercy. An elder invites the community, the household of Israel, and those who fear the LORD to repeat the declaration of God's steadfast love. The gathering includes farmers, elders, children, and travelers, each expressing gratitude. In the background, a prominent man stands beside a well-built house, while a modest worshipper waits at the sanctuary entrance, emphasizing the psalm's conviction that taking refuge in the LORD is better than trusting in human leaders or princes. The scene should not condemn all human leadership; it should show that ultimate trust belongs to God. Use realistic ancient Israelite garments, stone architecture, woven awnings, simple musical instruments, and warm daylight. No modern objects, readable banners, or fantasy effects.

title: The LORD Is My Strength and My Song
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper stands in an open valley after escaping a hostile confrontation. A group of adversaries remains at a distance on a ridge, while the worshipper moves toward the safety of a fortified path and raises his face in gratitude. A simple shield and walking staff lie nearby, suggesting the struggle without depicting physical injury. The worshipper's expression shows confidence that the LORD has helped him, strengthened him, and become his song and salvation. In the background, a sanctuary entrance and several people preparing to welcome him suggest that he will enter the gates of righteousness and give thanks. The imagery of being surrounded by enemies should remain symbolic and non-graphic; no one is shown harmed. Use historically plausible Israelite clothing, ancient shields, rocky terrain, and natural afternoon light. No modern weaponry, text, or fantasy effects.

title: The Stone the Builders Rejected
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of ancient Israelite builders works on a stone structure near a city gate. One carefully shaped stone has been set aside by a worker who considered it unsuitable, while another experienced builder recognizes that the stone fits an important corner of the building. The rejected stone is examined and then carefully placed into the structure, symbolizing the psalm's image of the stone rejected by builders becoming the chief cornerstone. Nearby, worshippers enter through a gate with branches and simple offerings, expressing joy in the day the LORD has made and gratitude for salvation. An elder raises his hands in blessing as the gathering responds with thanksgiving. The scene should represent the psalm's architectural metaphor without asserting that a specific construction event inspired it or inserting later events into an ancient setting. Use realistic stonecutting tools, limestone blocks, ancient garments, and natural sunlight. No modern cranes, cement, written text, or fantasy effects.
